title: Eubie Blake's fourteen-piece pit band
summary: He also played in the pit for Eubie Blake's shows with changing tempos, alongside Sweatman's stage act.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: My first time with Wilbur Sweatman, I went back with Dave Nelson. And I went back again with Eubie Blake. Because Eubie Blake had a fourteen-piece band.
Now, let's get some of this information in order here. You're saying that, in other words, you were working with Wilbur Sweatman around the same time...
And then at another time, you would work with Eubie.
I see. But they were like concurrent jobs.
We played with Eubie down in the pit...
For the shows. He had a fourteen-piece band. It was all about handling the levels, to find a way... The different tempo changes, you know...
Yes. What were some of those shows that Eubie was playing at that time?
Well, I remember, like, Sarah (?), Ida Cox, a comedian-dancer... I don't remember the comedian's name. There was a comedian-dancer there... "Open the door, Richard." Sandy Burns.
And they would do the Fresh Air Taxicab Company.
